Here's a summary of what was built:

**[`src/settlement.ts`](src/settlement.ts)** — exports:
- [`defaultDelay(ms)`](src/settlement.ts:7) — real `setTimeout`-based delay, used as the default parameter
- [`settle(payment, send, delay)`](src/settlement.ts:10) — iterates up to 3 attempts; on success returns `{ ...payment, status: 'settled' }`; after the third failure returns `{ ...payment, status: 'failed' }`; backoff waits are 10 ms → 20 ms → 40 ms (no wait after the final attempt); the `catch` block discards the error value entirely — no PAN is ever logged or re-thrown

**[`src/settlement.test.ts`](src/settlement.test.ts)** — 3 cases using `fakeDelay = () => Promise.resolve()` to skip actual waits:
1. Success on first try — `send` called once, status `'settled'`
2. Success on third try — `send` fails twice then resolves, status `'settled'`
3. Failure after three attempts — `send` always rejects, status `'failed'`, called exactly 3 times
